content: Standard single-submit offscreen Vulkan pattern: allocate a primary VkCommandBuffer from a VkCommandPool, vkBeginCommandBuffer (ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT), vkCmdBeginRenderPass (offscreen framebuffer, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE), vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdBindVertexBuffers/vkCmdBindIndexBuffer, push constants via vkCmdPushConstants or descriptor set via vkCmdBindDescriptorSets, vkCmdDrawIndexed (or vkCmdDraw if no index buffer), vkCmdEndRenderPass, then an explicit vkCmdPipelineBarrier to transition the color image to VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL if not already set via finalLayout, vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer into a HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT staging buffer, vkEndCommandBuffer. Submit via vkQueueSubmit with a VkFence, then vkWaitForFences (or vkDeviceWaitIdle per D-23) before mapping the staging buffer and reading results on the host -- fences are the correct host-GPU sync primitive for exactly this 'submit once, wait, then read' batch-job shape.
